description: This Java source file defines a Spring @Configuration class named OrganisationProvisioningConfiguration which configures various beans related to provisioning categories and criteria in the Apache Fineract project. It sets up service layer beans with conditional creation annotations.

classes.name: OrganisationProvisioningConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines beans for provisioning category and criteria services with conditional creation. It integrates various repositories, deserializers, and platform services for provisioning functionalities.

methods.name: provisioningCategoryReadPlatformService
methods.description: Defines a singleton bean for reading provisioning categories, using JDBC template.

methods.name: provisioningCategoryWritePlatformService
methods.description: Defines a singleton bean for writing provisioning categories, depending on repository, JSON deserializer, and JDBC template.

methods.name: provisioningCriteriaAssembler
methods.description: Constructs an assembler for provisioning criteria, injecting dependencies like JSON helper, repositories, and security context.

methods.name: provisioningCriteriaReadPlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for reading provisioning criteria, with dependencies on repositories, services, and JDBC template.

methods.name: provisioningCriteriaWritePlatformService
methods.description: Defines a bean for writing provisioning criteria, integrating deserializer, assembler, repositories, and other services.
